observed.caption: Elevated wide view of a large urban park with a curved lake in the foreground and a dense city skyline of high-rise buildings under a cloudy sky.
observed.description: The photo shows an elevated, wide-angle outdoor view looking across a large urban park toward a city skyline. In the immediate foreground are four long, low covered pavilion structures with tiered seating and distinctive white zigzag and flat roofs lining a reddish-brown dirt area. Directly behind them is a large, curved, reflective lake surrounded by green lawns, scattered mature trees with dense canopies, pathways, and small circular fountain monuments. Beyond the park, a road with tiny vehicles runs horizontally, with clusters of mid-rise and high-rise buildings of varying heights and designs extending across the horizon, including a prominent cylindrical tower on the right side. A large parking area filled with numerous small light-colored cars is visible behind trees on the right. The upper portion of the image is filled with a bright overcast sky with thick white and gray clouds. Small indistinct human figures are visible on pathways and near the pavilions, with one more distinct figure walking on the dirt in the foreground center.
